text:
These Aave and Morpho products quote higher rates
than a short-term Treasury fund.
But fees and access to your money matter.

USD 10,000 for 90 days: Aave earns about USD 11 more
than the Treasury fund after fees.
If rates hold. This is an example, not a forecast.
April's example used Aave V3. Today's products are different.
Available cash is shared, so immediate withdrawals aren't guaranteed.

Better apps should explain earnings after fees,
and how easily you can get your money back.
